entries.en: to pray to God; to say one's prayers
to pray and invoke God; to bless and beseech
to pray for; to entreat God
to say prayers; to pray
entries.notes: M 栏「tò chó」与「告」的常读不合，原稿另有 ✗ 校正符，读音存疑；释义依 H 栏「禱告」与 L 栏确定。

entries.en: to pray and invoke; to offer prayers

entries.zh: 祝告；向天主或圣人祈求
entries.en: to pray to God or to the saints; to invoke
to entreat; to plead insistently
to entreat urgently; to plead with insistence
entries.notes: H 栏为「懇求切」三字连读，非固定词形，M 栏亦按三节分读，末节 chiē« 带残符；词义由 L 栏 instancia 与 H 栏可定。

entries.zh: （向神像）陈情祈求，祈请神明鉴察接纳
entries.en: to pray to an idol; to beseech a deity to look down and accept
entries.notes: L 栏末尾 eiga 残损不明，M 栏标 [残]；H 栏「鑒納」为祈神受享的套语，据此定释。

entries.en: to pray to an idol for offspring; to ask for a son
entries.notes: L 栏「le eiga」残缺难读，M 栏标 [残]；H 栏「求嗣」明确，释为向神求子。

entries.en: to beg; to ask someone to give one something

entries.zh: 再三恳切强求；反复央告
entries.en: to entreat insistently; to press an earnest request
entries.notes: H 栏「估成」与 L 栏 encarecimiento（恳切强求）语义不直接对应，释义以 L 栏为主，H 栏字义存疑。

entries.en: to plead bitterly; to beg earnestly
to plead for reconciliation; to ask that they make friends
entries.notes: M 栏音标 T99 污损难辨；H 栏「覓解」当与「劝解」义通，L 栏「rogar sean amigos」即求人结好，据此定释。

entries.en: to entrust a request to another; to ask someone on another's behalf

entries.zh: 纠缠不休地求；死缠硬求
entries.en: to pester relentlessly; to press a request without letup
entries.notes: L 栏 rogar eficaçmente 之后有 ^ 与 [残]，整句不全；H 栏「纏腳纏手」为纠缠不放之意，据此定释。

entries.zh: 以好话央求；甜言相求（疑即「諂求」）
entries.en: to coax with fair words; to beg with flattery
entries.notes: H 栏首字标 [疑:諳/諂]，作「諂求」方与 L 栏 buenas palabras（好话）相合，故从諂。

entries.zh: 婉转求情；耐心温和地恳求、说合
entries.en: to plead tactfully; to intercede with patience and gentleness

entries.zh: 央请；托中间人说情，并为双方说合
entries.en: to ask a favour through an intermediary; to plead for both parties

entries.zh: 伤风咳嗽；鼻塞感冒（西语 romadizo，即伤风鼻塞）
entries.en: head cold, catarrh; cough
entries.notes: 词头 Rumadico 为 romadizo（伤风鼻塞）之异拼，H 栏「嗽」指咳嗽，二者属同一类伤风症候，故并列。

entries.en: stuffy nose; nasal congestion (catarrh)
entries.notes: 词头残作 nomadico（当即 romadizo），L、M 两栏均标 [残]，M 栏 T99 污损；仅 H 栏「鼻塞」明确，释义据此定，词头归属存疑。
